title: Brazil Reaches Record: 35% of Entrepreneurs Hold CNPJ
seoTitle: Record 35% of Entrepreneurs with CNPJ in Brazil
subtitle: 35% of Brazilian Entrepreneurs Now Formally Registered with CNPJ
excerpt: In the past year, 35% of the country's entrepreneurs were registered with the CNPJ, totaling 10.7 million individuals.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Out of every 100 entrepreneurs in Brazil last year, 35 were registered with the National Registry of Legal Entities (CNPJ), amounting to 10.7 million individuals in this category.

This percentage represents the highest proportion ever recorded by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) concerning the number of formalized entrepreneurs.

With information from Agência Brasil.
